"""Typed progress-emission contracts and state carriers."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Awaitable, Callable
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Protocol

from src.agui import BaseEvent, PlannerToAGUIAdapter
from src.autopilot.graph.run_summary import RunCompleteStats, SummaryModelProtocol
from src.types.typed import JsonObject


class ProgressDeps(Protocol):
    @property
    def adapter(self) -> PlannerToAGUIAdapter: ...

    emit_event: Callable[[BaseEvent], Awaitable[None]]


class SummaryProgressDeps(ProgressDeps, Protocol):
    @property
    def summary_llm_client(self) -> SummaryModelProtocol | None: ...

    @property
    def payload(self) -> JsonObject: ...


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SnapshotState:
    """Inputs carried on STATE_SNAPSHOT events."""

    actions: list[JsonObject]
    review_items: list[JsonObject]
    filled_count: int = 0
    # TODO: deduplicate with src/agui/params.py StateSnapshotParams
    guardrail_error: JsonObject | None = None
    correction_error: JsonObject | None = None
    job_metadata_signal: JsonObject | None = None
    job_metadata_result: JsonObject | None = None
    compensation_signal: JsonObject | None = None
    compensation_result: JsonObject | None = None
    accuracy_metrics: JsonObject | None = None
    evidence_ledger: JsonObject | None = None


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class FinalSummaryState:
    """Inputs used to build final run-complete summaries."""

    run_stats: RunCompleteStats
    review_items: list[JsonObject]
    resolved_actions: list[JsonObject]
    job_metadata_result: JsonObject | None = None


__all__ = [
    "FinalSummaryState",
    "ProgressDeps",
    "SnapshotState",
    "SummaryProgressDeps",
]
